name: Sweeping Axe (Recharge 5-6)
description: The creature makes a sweep with its axehand, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC: 17 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
